name: scheduler
description: Authenticated loopback scheduler with SQLite job and run persistence

capabilities.name: scheduler.cron
capabilities.description: Persist and execute cron jobs with one authoritative JobRun per execution

capabilities.name: scheduler.manual-run
capabilities.description: Trigger asynchronous manual runs and poll the same returned run_id

credentials.description: Optional explicit bearer token; a random local token is generated otherwise

health_checks.description: Verify scheduler dependencies, SQLite state and authenticated entry point

storage.description: Single source of truth for scheduler jobs, executions and migration state
Generated daemon bearer token; never print its value

job_types.report_collect: implemented, subject to collection pipeline limitations
job_types.custom: implemented for an exact module-and-function whitelist
job_types.memory_review: implemented as a read-only explicit task scan and local report

fallback: Without APScheduler the service reports degraded mode and refuses schedule creation rather than persisting false-active jobs
recovery: Legacy jobs.json migration is idempotent; SQLite remains authoritative and failed job restoration is recorded as an error
